name: Blender first scene: delete/add primitives, focus, F3 search, shade smooth, save
goal: Start a first Blender scene (Blender Guru donut/mug path or any beginner path): open Blender, navigate and recover with View Selected, use F3 operator search, Save As early, delete the default cube, add mesh primitives with the Add last-operation panel, Shade Smooth, practice G/R/S and Tab Object/Edit mode, and check camera framing with Numpad 0.

sources.title: Getting started - Blender for complete beginners

prerequisites: Ability to install apps or run portable Blender zip (or Blender already open)

outputs.name: scene_with_primitives
outputs.description: Saved .blend with user-added mesh primitives (e.g. torus/cylinder) shaded smooth

constraints: Prefer real MMB; else viewport gizmo or Edit→Preferences→Input→Emulate 3 Button Mouse (Alt+LMB)
Increase Preferences→Interface Resolution Scale on HiDPI (e.g. 1.5–1.8)
G grab, R rotate, S scale; Tab Object/Edit mode
Shift+A or Add menu for meshes
Numpad period focuses selection; Numpad 0 camera view

steps.action: Download Blender 5.x (or current) from blender.org; install or use portable zip; open and click off splash. Dismiss the splash.
Orbit MMB-drag; Shift+MMB pan; scroll zoom; use axis gizmo clicks if upside-down. Use View Selected (numpad period) if lost.
steps.expect: Can navigate and re-frame the selection

steps.action: Optional: Preferences → Interface Resolution Scale for readable UI; Input Emulate 3 Button Mouse if no MMB.
steps.expect: UI readable; MMB emulated if needed

steps.action: Learn F3 operator search (context-sensitive to Object mode vs elsewhere).
File → Save As to create your .blend early.
Select the default cube; X → Delete (Enter) to remove it.
Shift+A → Mesh → add primitives (cube, monkey, torus for the donut path / cylinder for the mug path); adjust Add last-operation settings before clicking away; practice add/delete.
steps.expect: New primitives added with tuned settings

steps.action: Right-click object → Shade Smooth when appropriate.
Practice G/R/S; Tab Edit mode to edit geometry; return to Object mode to select other objects.
Numpad 0 (or camera icon) to preview camera framing used for renders.

verification: Default cube removed and a new mesh added
